terminals.label: PE (frame)
terminals.detail: Frame bonding point. Not neutral, not a supply domain; no internal N-PE bond is modelled.

unsupported: Generic teaching source: not a physical genset model.
No kVA/kW rating, current limit or overload capability is modelled; the source is ideal (zero internal impedance).
Winding impedance, AVR/excitation, governor, fuel, engine RPM, transient/sub-transient reactance and short-circuit decrement are not modelled.
Synchronisation/paralleling with another source is not modelled: two independent sources feeding one three-phase machine are reported as unsynchronized.
PE is the frame bonding point only: no internal N-PE bond and no earthing system (TN/TT/IT) is implied.

documentation.teachingMode: Generic teaching source (three-phase + N). Artwork is illustrative.
documentation.electricalNote: Teaching settings: 230 V L-N, 50 Hz by default (adjustable). Balanced three-phase line-to-line = sqrt(3) x 230 V = 398.37 V, not 230 V. These are simulation settings, not ratings.
